verses.original: Συμεὼν Πέτρος δοῦλος καὶ ἀπόστολος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ Τοῖς ἰσότιμον ἡμῖν λαχοῦσιν πίστιν ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡμῶν καὶ Σωτῆρος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: Symeōn Petros doulos kai apostolos Iēsou Christou Tois isotimon hēmin lachousin pistin en dikaiosynē tou Theou hēmōn kai Sōtēros Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: Simon Peter a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ To those who through the righteousness of our God and Savior Jesus Christ have received a faith as precious as ours
verses.literalPt: Simão Pedro, servo e apóstolo de Jesus Cristo, aos que alcançaram fé igualmente preciosa conosco na justiça de nosso Deus e Salvador Jesus Cristo:

verses.original: Χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη πληθυνθείη ἐν ἐπιγνώσει τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ Ἰησοῦ τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: Charis hymin kai eirēnē plēthyntheiē en epignōsei tou Theou kai Iēsou tou Kyriou hēmōn
verses.literal: Grace and peace be multiplied to you through the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord
verses.literalPt: graça e paz vos sejam multiplicadas no pleno conhecimento de Deus e de Jesus, nosso Senhor.

verses.original: Ὡς τὰ πάντα ἡμῖν τῆς θείας δυνάμεως αὐτοῦ τὰ πρὸς ζωὴν καὶ εὐσέβειαν δεδωρημένης διὰ τῆς ἐπιγνώσεως τοῦ καλέσαντος ἡμᾶς ἰδίᾳ δόξῃ καὶ ἀρετῇ
verses.transliteration: Hōs ta panta hēmin tēs theias dynameōs autou ta pros zōēn kai eusebeian dedōrēmenēs dia tēs epignōseōs tou kalesantos hēmas idia doxē kai aretē
verses.literal: His divine power has given us everything we need for life and godliness through the knowledge of Him who called us by His own glory and excellence
verses.literalPt: Visto que o seu divino poder nos tem dado tudo o que diz respeito à vida e à piedade, pelo pleno conhecimento daquele que nos chamou por sua glória e virtude,

verses.original: δι’ ὧν τὰ τίμια καὶ μέγιστα ἡμῖν ἐπαγγέλματα δεδώρηται ἵνα διὰ τούτων γένησθε θείας κοινωνοὶ φύσεως ἀποφυγόντες τῆς ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ ἐν ἐπιθυμίᾳ φθορᾶς
verses.transliteration: di’ hōn ta timia kai megista hēmin epangelmata dedōrētai hina dia toutōn genēsthe theias koinōnoi physeōs apophygontes tēs en tō kosmō en epithymia phthoras
verses.literal: Through these He has given us His precious and magnificent promises so that through them you may become partakers of the divine nature now that you have escaped the corruption in the world caused by evil desires
verses.literalPt: pelas quais ele nos tem comunicado as suas preciosas e mui grandes promessas, para que por elas vos torneis participantes da natureza divina, tendo escapado da corrupção que há no mundo pela cobiça,

verses.original: Καὶ αὐτὸ τοῦτο δὲ σπουδὴν πᾶσαν παρεισενέγκαντες ἐπιχορηγήσατε ἐν τῇ πίστει ὑμῶν τὴν ἀρετήν ἐν δὲ τῇ ἀρετῇ τὴν γνῶσιν
verses.transliteration: Kai auto touto de spoudēn pasan pareisenenkantes epichorēgēsate en tē pistei hymōn tēn aretēn en de tē aretē tēn gnōsin
verses.literal: For this very reason make every effort to add to your faith virtue and to virtue knowledge
verses.literalPt: por isso mesmo, vós, aplicando da vossa parte toda a diligência, ajuntai à vossa fé a virtude;

verses.original: ἐν δὲ τῇ γνώσει τὴν ἐγκράτειαν ἐν δὲ τῇ ἐγκρατείᾳ τὴν ὑπομονήν ἐν δὲ τῇ ὑπομονῇ τὴν εὐσέβειαν
verses.transliteration: en de tē gnōsei tēn enkrateian en de tē enkrateia tēn hypomonēn en de tē hypomonē tēn eusebeian
verses.literal: and to knowledge self-control and to self-control perseverance and to perseverance godliness
verses.literalPt: à virtude, a ciência; à ciência, a temperança; à temperança, a fortaleza; à fortaleza, a piedade;

verses.original: ἐν δὲ τῇ εὐσεβείᾳ τὴν φιλαδελφίαν ἐν δὲ τῇ φιλαδελφίᾳ τὴν ἀγάπην
verses.transliteration: en de tē eusebeia tēn philadelphian en de tē philadelphia tēn agapēn
verses.literal: and to godliness brotherly kindness and to brotherly kindness love
verses.literalPt: à piedade, o amor dos irmãos; e, ao amor dos irmãos, a caridade.

verses.original: ταῦτα γὰρ ὑμῖν ὑπάρχοντα καὶ πλεονάζοντα οὐκ ἀργοὺς οὐδὲ ἀκάρπους καθίστησιν εἰς τὴν τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐπίγνωσιν
verses.transliteration: tauta gar hymin hyparchonta kai pleonazonta ouk argous oude akarpous kathistēsin eis tēn tou Kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou epignōsin
verses.literal: For if you possess these qualities and continue to grow in them they will keep you from being ineffective and unproductive in your knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ
verses.literalPt: Pois, se essas coisas vos pertencem e abundam em vós, fazem que não sejais ociosos nem sem fruto no pleno conhecimento de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo.

verses.original: ᾧ γὰρ μὴ πάρεστιν ταῦτα τυφλός ἐστιν μυωπάζων λήθην λαβὼν τοῦ καθαρισμοῦ τῶν πάλαι αὐτοῦ ἁμαρτιῶν
verses.transliteration: hō gar mē parestin tauta typhlos estin myōpazōn lēthēn labōn tou katharismou tōn palai autou hamartiōn
verses.literal: But whoever lacks these traits is nearsighted to the point of blindness having forgotten that he has been cleansed from his past sins
verses.literalPt: Mas aquele em quem não há essas coisas é cego, vendo só o que está perto, porque se tem esquecido da purificação dos seus pecados antigos.

verses.original: Διὸ μᾶλλον ἀδελφοί σπουδάσατε βεβαίαν ὑμῶν τὴν κλῆσιν καὶ ἐκλογὴν ποιεῖσθαι ταῦτα γὰρ ποιοῦντες οὐ μὴ πταίσητέ ποτε
verses.transliteration: Dio mallon adelphoi spoudasate bebaian hymōn tēn klēsin kai eklogēn poieisthai tauta gar poiountes ou mē ptaisēte pote
verses.literal: Therefore brothers strive . . . to make your calling and election sure For if you practice these things you will never . . . . . . stumble
verses.literalPt: Por isso, irmãos, ponde cada vez maior cuidado em fazer firme a vossa vocação e eleição; porque, fazendo isso, não tropeçareis jamais.

verses.original: οὕτως γὰρ πλουσίως ἐπιχορηγηθήσεται ὑμῖν ἡ εἴσοδος εἰς τὴν αἰώνιον βασιλείαν τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν καὶ Σωτῆρος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: houtōs gar plousiōs epichorēgēthēsetai hymin hē eisodos eis tēn aiōnion basileian tou Kyriou hēmōn kai Sōtēros Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: and . . . you will receive a lavish reception into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ
verses.literalPt: Pois assim vos será dada largamente a entrada no reino eterno de nosso Senhor e Salvador Jesus Cristo.

verses.original: Διὸ μελλήσω ἀεὶ ὑμᾶς ὑπομιμνῄσκειν περὶ τούτων καίπερ εἰδότας καὶ ἐστηριγμένους ἐν τῇ παρούσῃ ἀληθείᾳ
verses.transliteration: Dio mellēsō aei hymas hypomimnēskein peri toutōn kaiper eidotas kai estērigmenous en tē parousē alētheia
verses.literal: Therefore I will always remind you of these things even though you know them and are established in the truth you now have
verses.literalPt: Pois sempre estarei pronto para vos fazer lembrar essas coisas, ainda que as sabeis e estais confirmados na verdade que vos está presente.

verses.original: δίκαιον δὲ ἡγοῦμαι ἐφ’ ὅσον εἰμὶ ἐν τούτῳ τῷ σκηνώματι διεγείρειν ὑμᾶς ἐν ὑπομνήσει
verses.transliteration: dikaion de hēgoumai eph’ hoson eimi en toutō tō skēnōmati diegeirein hymas en hypomnēsei
verses.literal: I think it is right to refresh your memory as long as I live in the tent of my body
verses.literalPt: Tenho por justo, enquanto estou neste tabernáculo, despertar-vos com recordações,

verses.original: εἰδὼς ὅτι ταχινή ἐστιν ἡ ἀπόθεσις τοῦ σκηνώματός μου καθὼς καὶ ὁ Κύριος ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦς Χριστὸς ἐδήλωσέν μοι
verses.transliteration: eidōs hoti tachinē estin hē apothesis tou skēnōmatos mou kathōs kai ho Kyrios hēmōn Iēsous Christos edēlōsen moi
verses.literal: because I know that this tent will soon be laid aside as . . . our Lord Jesus Christ has made clear to me
verses.literalPt: sabendo que, brevemente, hei de deixar este meu tabernáculo, segundo o que também me deu a entender nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo.

verses.original: σπουδάσω δὲ καὶ ἑκάστοτε ἔχειν ὑμᾶς μετὰ τὴν ἐμὴν ἔξοδον τὴν τούτων μνήμην ποιεῖσθαι
verses.transliteration: spoudasō de kai hekastote echein hymas meta tēn emēn exodon tēn toutōn mnēmēn poieisthai
verses.literal: And . . . I will make every effort to ensure that after my departure you will be able to recall these things at all times
verses.literalPt: Mas terei cuidado também que, a todo tempo, depois da minha retirada, possais ter lembrança dessas coisas.

verses.original: Οὐ γὰρ σεσοφισμένοις μύθοις ἐξακολουθήσαντες ἐγνωρίσαμεν ὑμῖν τὴν τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ δύναμιν καὶ παρουσίαν ἀλλ’ ἐπόπται γενηθέντες τῆς ἐκείνου μεγαλειότητος
verses.transliteration: Ou gar sesophismenois mythois exakolouthēsantes egnōrisamen hymin tēn tou Kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou dynamin kai parousian all’ epoptai genēthentes tēs ekeinou megaleiotētos
verses.literal: For we did not follow cleverly devised fables when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ but we were eyewitnesses of His majesty
verses.literalPt: Pois não seguimos fábulas engenhosas, quando vos fizemos conhecer o poder e a vinda de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo; mas nós fomos testemunhas oculares da sua majestade,

verses.original: λαβὼν γὰρ παρὰ Θεοῦ Πατρὸς τιμὴν καὶ δόξαν φωνῆς ἐνεχθείσης αὐτῷ τοιᾶσδε ὑπὸ τῆς μεγαλοπρεποῦς δόξης Ὁ Υἱός μου ὁ ἀγαπητός μου οὗτός ἐστιν εἰς ὃν ἐγὼ εὐδόκησα
verses.transliteration: labōn gar para Theou Patros timēn kai doxan phōnēs enechtheisēs autō toiasde hypo tēs megaloprepous doxēs Ho Huios mou ho agapētos mou houtos estin eis hon egō eudokēsa
verses.literal: For He received honor and glory from God the Father when the voice came to Him from the Majestic Glory saying This is My - beloved Son in whom I am well pleased
verses.literalPt: porquanto ele recebeu de Deus Pai honra e glória, quando pela Magnífica Glória lhe foi comunicada esta voz: Este é o meu Filho dileto, em quem me agrado.

verses.original: καὶ ταύτην τὴν φωνὴν ἡμεῖς ἠκούσαμεν ἐξ οὐρανοῦ ἐνεχθεῖσαν σὺν αὐτῷ ὄντες ἐν τῷ ἁγίῳ ὄρει
verses.transliteration: kai tautēn tēn phōnēn hēmeis ēkousamen ex ouranou enechtheisan syn autō ontes en tō hagiō orei
verses.literal: And we ourselves heard this voice . . . from heaven when we were with Him on the holy mountain
verses.literalPt: Nós ouvimos essa voz, do céu comunicada, quando estávamos com ele no monte santo.

verses.original: Καὶ ἔχομεν βεβαιότερον τὸν προφητικὸν λόγον ᾧ καλῶς ποιεῖτε προσέχοντες ὡς λύχνῳ φαίνοντι ἐν αὐχμηρῷ τόπῳ ἕως οὗ ἡμέρα διαυγάσῃ καὶ φωσφόρος ἀνατείλῃ ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Kai echomen bebaioteron ton prophētikon logon hō kalōs poieite prosechontes hōs lychnō phainonti en auchmērō topō heōs hou hēmera diaugasē kai phōsphoros anateilē en tais kardiais hymōn
verses.literal: We also have the word of the prophets as confirmed beyond doubt And you will do well to pay attention to it as to a lamp shining in a dark place until the day dawns and the morning star rises in your hearts
verses.literalPt: Ainda temos mais segura a palavra dos profetas, a qual fazeis bem de atender, como a uma candeia que alumia num lugar escuro, até que o dia esclareça, e a estrela da alva surja nos vossos corações,

verses.original: τοῦτο πρῶτον γινώσκοντες ὅτι πᾶσα προφητεία γραφῆς ἰδίας ἐπιλύσεως οὐ γίνεται
verses.transliteration: touto prōton ginōskontes hoti pasa prophēteia graphēs idias epilyseōs ou ginetai
verses.literal: Above all you must understand that no . . . prophecy of Scripture comes from one’s own interpretation
verses.literalPt: conhecendo primeiro isto, que nenhuma profecia da Escritura é de particular interpretação,

verses.original: οὐ γὰρ θελήματι ἀνθρώπου ἠνέχθη προφητεία ποτέ ἀλλὰ ὑπὸ Πνεύματος Ἁγίου φερόμενοι ἐλάλησαν ἀπὸ Θεοῦ ἄνθρωποι
verses.transliteration: ou gar thelēmati anthrōpou ēnechthē prophēteia pote alla hypo Pneumatos Hagiou pheromenoi elalēsan apo Theou anthrōpoi
verses.literal: For no such prophecy was ever brought forth by the will of man but men spoke from God as they were carried along by the Holy Spirit
verses.literalPt: porque a profecia jamais foi dada pela vontade dos homens, mas os homens da parte de Deus falavam, movidos pelo Espírito Santo.
